title: Beal Level 26 Foundations v24.2.2: Logarithmic Bound log(1+x) ≤ x on Gap-3
description: Branch v24-matveev-log-one-plus-le from v24.2.1 ac100cf / 10.5281/zenodo.22731160. Keeps all v24.0.0 through v24.2.1 lemmas. Links the upper bound side toward Baker B0 = 10^6 reduction.
